component_boundaries.component_status: MNCS-L4 PASS in its captured development environment
component_boundaries.invalidation_trigger: Any EdgeStream frame, canonical event, candidate identity, or manifest change.

component_boundaries.component_status: Formal MNCS-L5 and MNCDS-D3 status UNKNOWN
component_boundaries.invalidation_trigger: Any Remote Water telemetry, planner, safety-kernel, or assurance identity change.

adapter_contract.device_scope: one declared EdgeStream device identifier per controller instance
adapter_contract.sequence_rule: Canonical event sequence numbers must be positive and strictly increasing; duplicate and replayed records are rejected.

metric_mapping.3: telemetry_quality encoded as 0 GOOD, 1 STALE, or 2 CONFLICT

adapter_contract.completion_rule: Emit one Remote Water telemetry sample only after all four metrics for one timestamp have been accepted by EdgeStream.
adapter_contract.rejection_rule: Reject incomplete timestamps, duplicate or non-monotonic sequences, unsupported metric values, mixed-device records, and invalid power or quality encodings.
